scope: Source review and engineering validation of PushT native-row data/cache preparation only; no predictor training, model selection, performance result, or official evaluation approved.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_real_video_iws.py tests/test_iws_internal_split.py
tests.final_delta_review: After test run, CLI/protocol status wording changed consistently from registered_before_feature_extraction to registered_before_full_cache_extraction and registration-specific zero counters were labeled. No loader, writer, extraction or test code changed.

independent_numeric_probe.scope: Independent synthetic numeric/row-contract probes; no dataset frame read or learned model inference

resolved_blocker.finding: A self-consistent cache produced under another registration or encoder could initially pass internal hash checks without comparison to the current static contract.
resolved_blocker.resolution: Current registration/split/input/config/preprocessing/batch/encoder static identity is now mandatory in IWSFeatureCache; production validation obtains it from checked_registration. Wrong-registration, encoder and config adversarial cases are covered.

reviewed_guards: Reserved/unknown episode IDs and wrong internal split rejected before payload paths are resolved/opened.
All native RGB frames and all N target_qpos rows retained with exact int64 native indices; sequential decode checks expected rows, dimensions, RGB conversion and source hashes.
Train-only float64 Welford feature-channel and action statistics reject dev, missing and duplicate records; shared channel layout matches 4x4 flattened features.
Pinned local DINO safetensor/config/preprocessor identities, preprocessing and FP32 pooling bound; CUDA BF16 and CPU FP32 paths cannot be mixed on resume.
Exclusive writer lock; episode arrays and receipt are verified in a private staging directory and atomically renamed together.
Incomplete hidden staging is never consumed; corrupt committed packages, missing receipts and identity changes fail without replacement.
All packages, statistics and registered source identities validated before complete manifest; complete reader requires the current registration identity.
Allocator-visible memory preflight and explicit launchers preserve resource limits; reviewer submitted no jobs.

author_real_data_preflight.note: Author performed and visually reviewed this actual-training compatibility probe. This reviewer read its source-bound receipt, not a new real-data decode.

limits: Previously viewed upstream-training000010 remains internal development and is explicitly disclosed.
Native N/N rows preserve the unresolved upstream s-to-s+59/60-command horizon convention; a separate model/window/evaluation protocol remains necessary.
CPU first/last-frame parity is engineering compatibility evidence, not full-GPU extraction validation or benchmark performance.
Complete-cache loader requires correct current static identity supplied by the checked production entry point; direct callers must retain this contract.
Hard-killed extraction can leave hidden staging directories, ignored rather than consumed; corrupt committed packages require explicit operational recovery.
registration_gate: Registration may freeze these reviewed sources; full extraction may then run under root scheduling and existing three-GPU quota. Any subsequent scientific source change requires review and a new registration version.
